excerpt: Paying customers are treated as disposable; the account was terminated under a broad policy without meaningful appeal.

For email campaigns, flows, and WooCommerce integrations, the interface was better and easier to use than alternatives.

Outlook compatibility was a specific problem for internal-communications use.

A user seeking system support was advised to use AI rather than receive direct guidance.
